## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (86%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set [F1], full model/neighbor agreement, and 0% invasive risk support routine review.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 86%, Benign 13%, InSitu 1%, Invasive 0% | Clear Normal lead; 0% invasive |
| Conformal set | {Normal} (α=10%, 90% dataset coverage) | Single class at 90% guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 80th OOD percentile (12/12 tiles) [F6] | Typical image; quality check passed |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree | Independent foundation models agree |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal (89–92% similarity) [F5] | All five neighbors are Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 8, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical (-0.67) [F2], but 0/20 AI spot check is unreliable · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 1, 2, 4) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical (-0.38) shifts prediction away from invasive [F3] · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 6) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical (+0.33) slightly raises invasive score [F4] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical (-0.31) opposes invasive carcinoma (20/20 spot check) · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top-3 risk regions drops invasive score above random (95% CI +0.0021 to +0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (95% CI -0.0088 to +0.0064 includes 0); leans on unreliable `normal_lobules` and `mitoses` (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Regions 6–7 harbor benign proliferation (`Benign` 13%), like contrast case `BACH_0115` (86% similarity; differs in `duct_confined`, `pleomorphism`).
- Lateral margin segment (`p=0.9965` vs `0.9998` threshold) or regions 6–7 contain focal atypia.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 6, 7**: Inspect highest-risk tiles (4%, 6% risk) where validated `invasion` (0.86) and `pleomorphism` (0.96) peak.
2. **Regions 3, 7**: Check lateral margin (`x=1792, y=256`; `p=0.9965` vs `0.9998` threshold) despite clear call [F7].
3. **Regions 1, 2, 4, 8, 10, 11**: Verify weak `tubules` and validated `benign_stroma_fat`; confirm unreliable `normal_lobules` (0/20).
